A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] '''inmate''' served as one of the proxies for the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Iram Radique]] aboard the [[Cog Hive Seven]] prison by the year [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who was on a mission aboard Cog Hive Seven to track down Radique, initially believed the Weequay to be Radique. Because of that, when Maul was forced to kill the Weequay during one of the gladiatorial matches taking place aboard the station, Maul believed that he had failed in his [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|mission]] to procure a nuclear device from Radique. However, Maul soon discovered that the Weequay had merely been one of Radique's lieutenants.
